text_en: Then all the congregation raised a loud cry, and the people wept that night.
text_cn: 全会众都大声喧嚷，人民哭了一夜。

text_en: And all the Israelites complained against Moses and Aaron; the whole congregation said to them, “Would that we had died in the land of Egypt! Or would that we had died in this wilderness!
text_cn: 以色列子民都抱怨梅瑟和亚郎；全会众对他们说：“巴不得我们都死在埃及地，都死在旷野里！

text_en: Why is the Lord bringing us into this land to fall by the sword? Our wives and our little ones will become booty; would it not be better for us to go back to Egypt? ”
text_cn: 为什么上主引我们到那地方死在刀下，叫我们的妻子儿女当作战利品？再回埃及去，为我们岂不更好？”

text_en: So they said to one another, “Let us choose a captain, and go back to Egypt. ”
text_cn: 于是彼此说：“我们另立头目，回埃及去。”

text_en: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the Israelites.
text_cn: 梅瑟和亚郎遂俯伏在以色列子民全会众前。

text_en: And Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh, who were among those who had spied out the land, tore their clothes
text_cn: 侦探那地方的人中，有农的儿子若苏厄和耶孚乃的儿子加肋布，他们撕裂了自己的衣服，

text_en: and said to all the congregation of the Israelites, “The land that we went through as spies is an exceedingly good land.
text_cn: 告诉以色列子民全会众说：“我们侦探所经过的地方，确是一片极好的地方。

text_en: If the Lord is pleased with us, he will bring us into this land and give it to us, a land that flows with milk and honey.
text_cn: 若上主恩待我们，必引我们到那里去，将那地方赐给我们。那实在是一块流奶流蜜的地方。

text_en: Only, do not rebel against the Lord ; and do not fear the people of the land, for they are no more than bread for us; their protection is removed from them, and the Lord is with us; do not fear them. ”
text_cn: 只要你们不反抗上主，就不必怕那地方的人民，因为他们要作我们的掠物；护佑他们的，离开了他们，上主却与我们同在；所以不要怕他们。”

text_en: But the whole congregation threatened to stone them. Then the glory of the Lord appeared at the tent of meeting to all the Israelites.
text_cn: 全会众正说要用石头砸死他们时，上主的荣耀在会幕上显示给全以色列子民。

text_en: And the Lord said to Moses, “How long will this people despise me? And how long will they refuse to believe in me, in spite of all the signs that I have done among them?
text_cn: 上主对梅瑟说：“这人民轻慢我要到几时呢？我虽在他们中行了那些神迹，他们仍不相信我，要到几时呢？

text_en: I will strike them with pestilence and disinherit them, and I will make of you a nation greater and mightier than they. ”
text_cn: 我要用瘟疫打击他们，铲除他们，使你成为一个比他们更强大，更昌盛的民族。”

text_en: But Moses said to the Lord , “Then the Egyptians will hear of it, for in your might you brought up this people from among them,
text_cn: 但是梅瑟对上主说：“埃及人如果听说这事，因为你曾用威力由他们中领出这民族来，

text_en: and they will tell the inhabitants of this land. They have heard that you, O Lord , are in the midst of this people; for you, O Lord , are seen face to face, and your cloud stands over them and you go in front of them, in a pillar of cloud by day and in a pillar of fire by night.
text_cn: 他们将说什么？这地方的居民也曾听说：你上主是在这民族中；你上主曾面对面地发显出来，你的云彩常停在他们上面；白日你乘云柱，黑夜你乘火柱，走在他们前面。

text_en: Now if you kill this people all at one time, then the nations who have heard about you will say,
text_cn: 现在，如果你消灭这民族如消灭一个人一样，这些曾听到你声名的外邦民族必要议论说：

text_en: ‘It is because the Lord was not able to bring this people into the land he swore to give them that he has slaughtered them in the wilderness. ’
text_cn: ‘由于上主不能引这民族进入他对他们所誓许的地方，就在旷野将他们杀了。’

text_en: And now, therefore, let the power of the Lord be great in the way that you promised when you spoke, saying,
text_cn: 吾主，如今求你，大发宽容，如你曾声明说：

text_en: ‘The Lord is slow to anger, and abounding in steadfast love, forgiving iniquity and transgression, but by no means clearing the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the parents upon the children to the third and the fourth generation. ’
text_cn: 上主缓于发怒，富于仁慈，宽赦过犯和罪过，但决不豁免惩罚，父亲的过犯，要向子孙追讨，直到三代四代。

text_en: Forgive the iniquity of this people according to the greatness of your steadfast love, just as you have pardoned this people, from Egypt even until now. ”
text_cn: 求你大发仁慈，宽恕这人民的罪过，就如从埃及一直到现在，你宽赦了他们一样。”

text_en: Then the Lord said, “I do forgive, just as you have asked;
text_cn: 上主回答说：“我就照你祈求的宽赦他们；

text_en: nevertheless—as I live, and as all the earth shall be filled with the glory of the Lord —
text_cn: 但是我以我的生命，以充满全地的上主的荣耀起誓：

text_en: none of the people who have seen my glory and the signs that I did in Egypt and in the wilderness, and yet have tested me these ten times and have not obeyed my voice,
text_cn: 这些见了我的荣耀，见了我在埃及和旷野里所行的神迹的人，已十次试探了我，不听我的话，

text_en: shall see the land that I swore to give to their ancestors; none of those who despised me shall see it.
text_cn: 他们决不能见我对他们祖先誓许的地方；凡轻慢我的人，决不会见到那地方。

text_en: But my servant Caleb, because he has a different spirit and has followed me wholeheartedly, I will bring into the land into which he went, and his descendants shall possess it.
text_cn: 惟有我的仆人加肋布，因怀有另一种精神，全心服从我，我必引他进入他去过的地方，他的后裔必占有那地方为产业。

text_en: Now, since the Amalekites and the Canaanites live in the valleys, turn tomorrow and set out for the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea. ”
text_cn: 现今阿玛肋克人和客纳罕人盘据在山谷中，明天你们应转身向红海出发，往旷野去。”

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying:
text_cn: 上主吩咐梅瑟和亚郎说：

text_en: How long shall this wicked congregation complain against me? I have heard the complaints of the Israelites, which they complain against me.
text_cn: “这个邪恶的会众抱怨我要到几时？以色列子民抱怨我的话我都听见了。

text_en: Say to them, “As I live, ” says the Lord , “I will do to you the very things I heard you say:
text_cn: 你对他们说：我以我的生命起誓：──上主的断语──我必照你们在我耳中所说的话，对待你们：

text_en: your dead bodies shall fall in this very wilderness; and of all your number, included in the census, from twenty years old and upward, who have complained against me,
text_cn: 你们中凡二十岁以上登过记的，凡抱怨过我的，都要倒毙在这旷野中。

text_en: not one of you shall come into the land in which I swore to settle you, except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.
text_cn: 你们决不得进入我誓许给你们居住的地方，只有耶孚乃的儿子加肋布和农的儿子若苏厄除外。

text_en: But your little ones, who you said would become booty, I will bring in, and they shall know the land that you have despised.
text_cn: 至于你们的幼童，你们曾说他们要当战利品的，我要领他们进去，使他们享受你们所轻视的地方。

text_en: But as for you, your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness.
text_cn: 至于你们，你们必倒毙在这旷野中；

text_en: And your children shall be shepherds in the wilderness for forty years, and shall suffer for your faithlessness, until the last of your dead bodies lies in the wilderness.
text_cn: 你们的子女要在旷野漂流四十年，受你们背信之罚，直到你们的尸首在旷野中烂尽。

text_en: According to the number of the days in which you spied out the land, forty days, for every day a year, you shall bear your iniquity, forty years, and you shall know my displeasure. ”
text_cn: 你们侦探那地方的日子，共计四十天，一天算一年，你们应受四十年的罪罚，叫你们知道我放弃你们是什么一回事。

text_en: I the Lord have spoken; surely I will do thus to all this wicked congregation gathered together against me: in this wilderness they shall come to a full end, and there they shall die.
text_cn: 我上主既说了，也必对这聚集反抗我的邪恶会众这样做：在这旷野他们都要灭绝，在这里都要死尽。”

text_en: And the men whom Moses sent to spy out the land, who returned and made all the congregation complain against him by bringing a bad report about the land—
text_cn: 梅瑟派遣去侦探那地方的人，回来以后，对那地方散布谣言，致使全会众抱怨梅瑟。

text_en: the men who brought an unfavorable report about the land died by a plague before the Lord .
text_cn: 这些对那地方讲说坏话的人，都遭了灾罚，死在上主面前；

text_en: But Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh alone remained alive, of those men who went to spy out the land.
text_cn: 前去侦探那地方的人，只有农的儿子若苏厄和耶孚乃的儿子加肋布，保全了性命。

text_en: When Moses told these words to all the Israelites, the people mourned greatly.
text_cn: 梅瑟将这些话告诉了全以色列子民；人民都非常忧闷。

text_en: They rose early in the morning and went up to the heights of the hill country, saying, “Here we are. We will go up to the place that the Lord has promised, for we have sinned. ”
text_cn: 次日清晨他们起来，要上山顶去，说：“我们犯了罪，现在我们已准备好，要往上主所说的地方去。”

text_en: But Moses said, “Why do you continue to transgress the command of the Lord ? That will not succeed.
text_cn: 但是梅瑟说：“你们为什么要违背上主的命令？这事必不会成功。

text_en: Do not go up, for the Lord is not with you; do not let yourselves be struck down before your enemies.
text_cn: 不要上去，因为上主不在你们中间，难免不被敌人击败。

text_en: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites will confront you there, and you shall fall by the sword; because you have turned back from following the Lord , the Lord will not be with you. ”
text_cn: 因为阿玛肋克人和客纳罕人在那里要抵挡你们，你们必丧身刀下；你们既背离了上主，上主自然不再与你们同在。”

text_en: But they presumed to go up to the heights of the hill country, even though the ark of the covenant of the Lord , and Moses, had not left the camp.
text_cn: 他们仍擅自上了山顶；但上主的约柜和梅瑟没有由营幕中移动。

text_en: Then the Amalekites and the Canaanites who lived in that hill country came down and defeated them, pursuing them as far as Hormah.
text_cn: 住在山中的阿玛肋克人和客纳罕人就下来，击杀了他们，将他们追击到曷尔玛。
